scope: authenticated checkpoint-only Stage-2 reconstruction and postprocessing; no Stage-1 spatial solve or gate optimization

definitions.enumerated_paths: all 9*8=72 ordered paths with distinct m1,m2 in states 2..10
definitions.operator_active_path: all three N71 |grid_phi| edges are at least 1e-8
definitions.serious_candidate: operator-active and N71 coupling product at least 1% of the best path; this transparent reporting cutoff is not a physical sufficiency criterion
definitions.active_transition_for_crowding: an unordered low-11 transition with |grid_phi| at least 1e-8
definitions.crowding: for each carrier, nearest other active low-11 transition; another intended path edge is retained as a competitor and flagged

pareto_objectives.note: No weighted aggregate score is formed. Other reported stability and character metrics remain diagnostic rather than hidden Pareto weights.

N51.interpretation: This is an empirical selection-rule-like pattern of the stored grid_phi matrix only. No saved symmetry/parity operator supports assigning a physical parity quantum number.

N71.interpretation: This is an empirical selection-rule-like pattern of the stored grid_phi matrix only. No saved symmetry/parity operator supports assigning a physical parity quantum number.

limitations: Only states 0..10 are available in the saved Stage-2 reference.
Crowding excludes transitions involving states above 10.
Static matrix elements and detunings do not predict driven pulse fidelity.
The saved checkpoints contain no physical parity/symmetry operator.
No parasitic-capacitance or other omitted-physics perturbation exists in the saved data.
N71 retained-basis evidence stops at the k180 parent with k170/k172/k175 reductions; k220 is pending.
N51-to-N71 is a spatial-grid comparison, not a physical-model robustness test.
